bridge_functions.name: Confetti.Burst
bridge_functions.description: Trigger a burst on a mounted <native:confetti> element from anywhere — an action method that doesn't hold the element's fire-token. Params: ref (string, optional, defaults to 'default' — the element's own ref attribute, or 'default' if unset). Async — dispatches ConfettiBurstFailed if no confetti element with that ref is mounted; on success the element's own burst (and, once it ends, its on_finished callback) fires exactly as if fire-token had been bumped.
